answer: In a coastal haven, agents mapping violet flowers on a dune could need exclusive radio leases to earn. A registry binds each lease serial to one signing key for the epoch; validators reject another claim on that serial. Every added alias must rent another channel, even in a parallel colluding farm. Require the recurring lease price to exceed the capped extra-alias subsidy. The scheme trusts an honest registry, enforceable spectrum exclusivity and a credible cap; sham leases defeat it. Short, narrow-area leases offer newcomers entry but still impose a price barrier.
